# n8n-nodes-brainiall

Source: https://github.com/fasuizu-br/n8n-nodes-brainiall/blob/main/README.md

# n8n-nodes-brainiall

This is an n8n community node for the **Brainiall LLM Gateway** -- access 113+ AI models from 17 providers through a single OpenAI-compatible API.

[n8n](https://n8n.io/) is a fair-code licensed workflow automation platform.

## Installation

Follow the [installation guide](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/) in the n8n community nodes documentation.

**Quick steps:**

1. Open your n8n instance
2. Go to **Settings > Community Nodes**
3. Click **Install**
4. Enter `n8n-nodes-brainiall`
5. Click **Install**

## Credentials

1. Go to [brainiall.com](https://brainiall.com) and sign up for an API key
2. In n8n, go to **Credentials > New Credential**
3. Search for **Brainiall API**
4. Enter your API key
5. Click **Save** -- the credential will be tested automatically against the `/models` endpoint

## Node: Brainiall LLM

### Operations

| Operation | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| **Chat Completion** | Send messages to any model and get a response |
| **List Models** | Retrieve the full catalog of available models |

### Available Models

The node includes a dropdown with popular models pre-configured:

**Anthropic**: Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Haiku 4.5

**DeepSeek**: DeepSeek R1, DeepSeek V3

**Meta**: Llama 4 Scout 17B, Llama 3.3 70B, Llama 3.1 405B, Llama 3.1 70B, Llama 3.1 8B

**Qwen**: Qwen 3 235B, Qwen 3 30B

**Mistral**: Mistral Large 3, Mistral Small 3

**Amazon**: Nova Pro, Nova Lite, Nova Micro

**MiniMax**: MiniMax M2

You can also select **Custom Model ID** to use any model from the full catalog of 113+ models.

### Options

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| Temperature | Controls randomness (0-2) | 1.0 |
| Max Tokens | Maximum tokens in the response | 4096 |
| Top P | Nucleus sampling threshold | 1.0 |
| Frequency Penalty | Penalize repeated tokens (-2 to 2) | 0 |
| Presence Penalty | Penalize tokens already in text (-2 to 2) | 0 |
| JSON Mode | Force valid JSON output | false |
| Stop Sequences | Comma-separated stop strings | - |
| System Message | System prompt (used with simple Prompt field) | - |

### Input

You can provide input in two ways:

1. **Messages** (structured): Add multiple messages with role (system/user/assistant) and content
2. **Prompt** (simple): Enter a single user prompt. Optionally add a System Message in Options

If both are provided, Messages takes precedence.

### Output

Each item returns:

```json
{
  "content": "The model's response text",
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "finish_reason": "stop",
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 25,
    "completion_tokens": 150,
    "total_tokens": 175
  },
  "id": "chatcmpl-...",
  "full_response": { ... }
}
```

## Compatibility

- n8n version 1.0+
- Tested with n8n 1.70+

## API Information

- **Base URL**: `https://apim-ai-apis.azure-api.net/v1`
- **Auth**: Bearer token (OpenAI-compatible)
- **Endpoints**: `/chat/completions`, `/models`
- **Format**: 100% OpenAI API compatible

## Resources

- [Brainiall Website](https://brainiall.com)
- [n8n Community Nodes Documentation](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/)
